column1: eval-003,test,direct_factual,When should I choose an impression-based IO instead of a budget-based IO?,,Choose an impression-based IO when monetary budgets are somewhat flexible and your main intent is to generate a certain number of impressions.,"- Impression-based fits when monetary budgets are somewhat flexible

- The main intent is to generate a certain number of impressions","You should choose an impression-based IO when your monetary budgets are somewhat flexible and your main intent is to generate a certain number of impressions. Impression-based IOs are suitable if you want to emphasize brand exposure and ad visibility, aiming to deliver a specific number of impressions across the IO's campaigns. This type of IO sets an overall cap on the total number of impressions for the campaigns assigned to it, and the campaigns will stop serving once their cumulative impressions reach that limit. This approach helps ensure you don't overspend based on the overall IO impression budget.
In contrast, budget-based IOs are better when monetary budgets are fixed and you want to regulate overall campaign spending with a defined spend cap.

To create a budget-based IO, open the Campaigns app, select + Create Insertion Order, and choose Budget under Budget Type. The Budget Type can't be changed after the IO is created.","- Budget-based IOs set a monetary cap on spend; impression-based IOs cap impressions
- In the Campaigns app, select + Create Insertion Order
- Choose Budget in the Budget Type section
- The Budget Type can't be changed after creation","The difference between budget-based and impression-based Insertion Orders (IOs) is primarily in their goals and budget management:

- **Budget-based IOs** set a fixed monetary cap for the total spend of the campaigns assigned to the IO. Campaigns stop serving impressions once their cumulative spend reaches this budget. This type is suitable when you want to regulate overall campaign spending and have a fixed spend budget.

- **Impression-based IOs** set a cap on the total number of impressions for the campaigns assigned to the IO. Campaigns stop serving once their cumulative impressions reach this limit. This type is ideal when your goal is brand exposure and ad visibility, with flexible monetary spending.
To create a budget-based IO from the Campaigns app:
1. When creating a new IO, choose the **Budget Type** as **Budget** for a budget-based IO.
2. Set the overall monetary budget cap for the IO.
Note that the Budget Type cannot be changed after the IO is created.

For more detailed steps on creating a budget-based IO, you would typically follow the process in the Campaigns app, selecting the budget-based option during IO creation.",answered,answered,"https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/8481053-budget-based-and-impression-based-insertion-order-io-overview

column1: eval-012,test,multi_section,"What is a Pre-bid audience, and how do I add one to a new campaign from the Campaigns app?",,"A Pre-bid audience is a group of fraud and invalid traffic (IVT), brand suitability, viewability and supply refinement pre-bid segments that you select. To add one: open the Campaigns app, choose an IO, click + Create Campaign, expand the Pre-bid Audience section, and pick an audience from the Select Audiences menu (or add individual segments).","- Pre-bid audiences group IVT, brand suitability, viewability and supply refinement pre-bid segments
- Open the Campaigns app, choose an IO and click + Create Campaign
- Expand the Pre-bid Audience section

- Choose an existing audience from Select Audiences, or add individual segments","A Pre-bid audience is a group of multiple pre-bid segments combined to ensure higher media quality and ad targeting that aligns with a brand's standards. These segments include fraud, invalid traffic (IVT), brand suitability, viewability, and supply refinement criteria. Advertisers use pre-bid targeting to verify each impression before bidding, helping to avoid eliminating entire sites unnecessarily. Creating a Pre-bid audience is recommended when you want to use the same set of pre-bid segments across multiple campaigns, allowing you to add the audience to each campaign instead of manually selecting segments each time.
To add a Pre-bid audience to a new campaign from the Campaigns app, follow these steps:
1. Open the Campaigns app.
2. Choose an Insertion Order (IO) to go to the Insertion Order Info page.
3. Click **+ Create Campaign** to open the new campaign form.
4. Locate and expand the **Pre-bid Audience** section.
5. To add an existing audience, open the **Select Audiences** menu and click the audience's name.
6. To add individual segments, click **+ Add Pre-bid Segments**, then search for and select the desired segments.
7. Review and manage the segments added; you can remove any unwanted segments without affecting the original Pre-bid audience.
8. Optionally, save your targeting settings as a new campaign template.
9. Save your changes by clicking **Save as Draft** or **Run** to create the campaign.
Note that the platform supports one creative type per campaign, so choose only one format (Display or Video) for pre-bid segments to avoid extra charges.

This process allows you to efficiently apply pre-bid targeting to your new campaign to improve media quality and brand safety.",answered,answered,"https://help.iqm.com/en/articles/11497708-campaign-targeting-guide
